# Files that 1.2.2 DELETED.
#
# When 1.2.2 is copied on top of an older (1.2.1) repository, deleted files are
# not removed by the copy and stay behind as orphans. They still reference
# symbols and string resources that no longer exist, which breaks the Kotlin
# compile even though the shipped source tree is fine. scripts/purge-stale-sources.sh
# removes exactly the paths listed here before the build, so a release can never
# be broken by a leftover file again.
#
# One repo-relative path per line. Only app/, native/aether/aether/src/ and
# docs/ paths are accepted.

# --- in-app updater (removed in 1.2.2: the app no longer downloads APKs) ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/UpdateChecker.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/UpdateInstaller.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/UpdateDownloader.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/UpdatePrompt.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/UpdateDialog.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/UpdatePanel.kt

# --- country / location picker (removed in 1.2.2: anycast makes it meaningless) ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/Locations.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/LocationPanel.kt

# --- forced clean-exit policy (removed in 1.2.2 at the user's request) ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/CleanExit.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/ExitGuard.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/core/BadEdgeStore.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/ExitPolicyCard.kt
native/aether/aether/src/geoguard.rs

# --- Tor backend (removed in 1.2.7: TCP-only, so all device UDP had to be
#     faked out of its DNSPort, and bootstrapping through the Aether handshake
#     read as a hang) ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/transport/TorTransport.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/transport/TorSocksFront.kt
scripts/build-tor.sh

# --- superseded by the unified connection card (removed in 1.2.6) ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/StatusLine.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/TrafficPanel.kt
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/ConnectionMeta.kt

# --- dead resource swept by the 1.2.7 security audit: the FileProvider that
#     used it went with the in-app updater in 1.2.2, so these paths described an
#     export path that no longer exists ---
app/src/main/res/xml/file_paths.xml

# --- superseded by the settings screen (removed in 1.2.7): the single
#     ~900-line "Advanced settings" card. Its controls now live in
#     app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/settings/. ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/AdvancedPanel.kt

# --- superseded by the bottom-sheet choice row (removed in 1.2.7): a
#     DropdownMenu cannot present 56 exit countries usably on a phone. ---
app/src/main/java/studio/cluvex/aether/ui/components/DropdownSelector.kt
